adaptations: Parameterize and verify native model/effort, default gpt-6-astra/medium.
Remove credential-copy option; native Codex handles its existing login.
Do not poll account rate limits per visual call.

limitations: This is a new method candidate, not a measured v4 success.
Development scheduling probes do not measure native model response latency or semantic accuracy.
Finite empirical timing envelopes do not guarantee future tails; shared-world lock contention remains unchanged.
Per-carrier short fresh context, task decomposition, concurrency, model-call volume and provided engineering all vary jointly from the standard outer-agent workflow.
No claim that SOOOOL alone, queue alone, concurrency alone, or profile alone accounts for an outcome.
v4_local_adaptations: DEV-only raw public act/PNG transport probes, preserving requests, responses, timing and unknown failures; no model calls.
Local schedule-search adapter executes the unchanged SOOOOL timed-key executor under a virtual clock; no upstream visual simulator or training claim.
The measured lead and public full-window expiry are instructions for the model; literal timestamps remain unmodified.

Public opportunity reservation before capture/request prevents late-model-callback capture races; accept/uncertain/invalid/failure release provisional reservations only. Model-bound taps retain protection until server receipt or finite expiry; no callback is held for PNG.
Four native workers by default, no hedging or additional semantic review; fresh thread per carrier inherited from v3.
Require observed clock_rate=1 initially and on every execution loop; never apply a speed-1 DEV policy to an accelerated clock.
v4_native_transport_status: Copied byte-for-byte from v3; no new transport, model, effort, or nested tool changes.
